text:
linda_csm: Heads up — CloverWorks renewal flagged. Usage down ~68% last 30d, new procurement PM (Marisol) joined this week. I think they're evaluating NebulaAI pilot.
aj_sales: saw the RFP note, thanks. Do we have logs on rate-limits / errors from their integration?
devon_prodsup: quick check — no recent 500 spikes from our side, but a lot of client-side 429s in the gateway logs. suspect aggressive retry logic. Query we ran:
```
SELECT day, sum(requests) as reqs, sum(errors) as errs
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_clover'
AND day >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
linda_csm: thanks. Marisol said latency variability is a concern — they want dedicated throughput for inference. Nebula is pitching lower-latency model + custom quant.
emily_renewals: can we offer a timeboxed dedicated pilot? 6 wks with SLOs, plus a migration assist. Sales could pair on commercial terms.
aj_sales: yes — we can propose a pilot discount and dedicated pool cap. Need ops to confirm capacity and eng to agree on SLO wording.
marc_engineer: ops can support a small dedicated pool. Can we scope token QPS and peak concurrency? I need numbers.
devon_prodsup: from logs, 95th token QPS ~120, avg mem per request low. If they move to streaming chat, concurrency could triple. Recommend 2-GPU reserved pool for pilot.
linda_csm: action items:
- @aj_sales schedule intro w/Marisol + exec 1:1 (this week)
- @emily_renewals draft pilot commercial (6wks, discount, rollback clause)
- @marc_engineer confirm pilot SLO + capacity by EOD tomorrow
- @devon_prodsup share trimmed usage CSV and top 10 prompt sets
ops_bot: [automation] Created ticket #CS-8932 for 'CloverWorks pilot capacity' and assigned to eng-oncall.
emily_renewals: also capturing a competitive note — they're sensitive to latency but care about cost predictability. Include our batching + KV-cache improvements in the pitch.
aj_sales: I'll request Marisol's calendar. Linda please DM me the stakeholder map (exec + engineering leads).
linda_csm: sending map now. Also capturing feedback: their PM said "need predictable per-call latency under 180ms" — might be strict depending on model.
marc_engineer: noted. If they require <180ms tail, we'll propose model variant + lower seq length and aggressive caching. Might need quantized 4-bit build.
linda_csm: ok everyone — let's reconvene after sales intro. If pilot accepted, prioritize a QBR + hands-on apps session. :thumbsup:
aj_sales: ack. I'll update thread with calendar invite.
ops_bot: [reminder] CS-8932 due in 48h for capacity confirmation.
